description: Explains one accessibility rule from a check_accessibility result: what it means, who it affects, how to fix it, the WCAG success criteria it maps to (with W3C links), and a reference page.

rule_id.description: The rule id shown in a check_accessibility result, e.g. "color-contrast", "button-name", "keyboard-trap".

name: explain_issue
title: Explain an accessibility rule
